newsitem.title: USA: Vermont Financial holders ok acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Vermont Financial holders ok acquisition.

text.p: Vermont Financial Services Corp and Eastern Bancorp said Monday stockholders of both companies have approved their previously announced merger.
The companies said the deal calls for Eastern Bancorp to be folded into Vermont Financial as a wholly owned subsidiary. Terms were not disclosed.
The merger will result in Vermont Financial having about $2.2 billion in assets and 54 offices in Vermont, New Hampshre and Massachusetts, the company said.

The merger, initiated in November 1996, has been approved by the U.S. Federal Reserve but awaits approval from the Massachusetts Board of Bank Inc., the company said. Pending that approval, the merger is expected to close in June.
